name: anime-stream-scraping-playbook
purpose: Reusable methods for scraping real playable anime streams (m3u8/mp4 + referer + subtitles) from aggregator sites, so another AI can apply them to any site.
golden_rules: A proxy path (cors.x.com/proxy/e/...) is NEVER the real URL; resolve or verify it.
Verify every claim with a real fetch: 200 + valid #EXTM3U + a segment that downloads.
Referer is mandatory on SEGMENTS, not just the master.
Upstream episode.id / titles lie; trust the resolved URL + on-device playback.
Don't drop a server as 'browser-only' until you've tried node-decode of its client JS.
Bind Flask to $PORT for Render; absolutize subtitle URLs; use 2-letter lang codes.

M1_cors_proxy_passthrough.mechanism: GET the proxy URL with the site referer; it returns the real m3u8 (segments may be relative).

M2_embed_m3u8_extraction.symptom: API gives an iframe URL; page JS contains a literal m3u8
M2_embed_m3u8_extraction.mechanism: GET iframe; regex the literal https://<host>/.../master.m3u8; referer = iframe host.

M3_node_packer_decode.symptom: Player page has eval(function(p,a,c,k,e,d){...}) packer; real URL hidden
M3_node_packer_decode.mechanism: Extract balanced-paren eval block; run in node with jwplayer.setup hook; read SETUP_FILE.

M4_self_resolve_from_source.mechanism: Identify real source; resolve correct episode by title/slug; pick typed mirror tab (raw/sub/dub).

M5_redirect_follow_mp4.mechanism: Return play/<id>/video.mp4; hardcode Referer (API often omits it).

M6_api_contract_mirror.symptom: Want new scraper to plug into existing app with no app changes
M6_api_contract_mirror.mechanism: Flask API with /servers, /stream, /proxy matching anikage contract; bind $PORT.

M7_subtitle_handling.mechanism: Absolutize subtitle URL against backend BASE; use 2-letter lang (en not eng); proxy same-origin.

M8_title_to_slug.mechanism: lowercase+hyphenate; try -tv/-dub variants; reuse aggregator slug when valid; reject corrupt (e.g. your-name).

otakuhg.site.detail: packed jwplayer; node-decode -> master.txt on random *.site/*.space CDN; referer mandatory

animegg.org.detail: typed mirror tabs; play/<id>/video.mp4 302 -> vidcache; referer mandatory

megaplay.detail: trust aggregator-resolved URL; don't re-derive id from anilist

decision_tree: API url? cors token(M1) -> fetch+referer; iframe(M2) -> literal or packer(M3); wrong content(M4); .mp4(M5). Always verify 200+HLS+segment, always absolutize subs (M7).
